title: Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer
Up to £45,000

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Data Engineer to join an established and growing UK business, where data plays an increasingly important role in shaping business decisions and driving performance.

Joining the technology team, you will have the opportunity to work with modern data technologies, build reliable data solutions and support stakeholders across multiple business functions. This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to develop their career while making a tangible impact within a growing organisation.

As a Data Engineer, you will play a key role in developing and maintaining the company's data platform, ensuring business-critical data is accurate, accessible and trusted. Working within a collaborative technology team, you will help deliver data-driven insights that support both operational and strategic decision-making across the business.

You will work closely with technical and non-technical stakeholders alike, contributing to data engineering, reporting, analytics and data quality initiatives. This is a hands-on position offering the opportunity to influence how data is leveraged across the organisation while continuing to develop your technical skills in a supportive and growing environment.

Key Responsibilities
* Develop, maintain and enhance data pipelines and data models.
* Build and optimise SQL-based transformations and reporting datasets.
* Write complex SQL queries to answer business-critical questions.
* Create and maintain dashboards and reports that provide actionable insights.
* Monitor and improve data quality across the organisation.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver effective data solutions.

Skills & Experience
* Previous experience in a Data Engineer, Data Analyst, BI Developer or similar data-focused role.
* Strong SQL development and query-writing skills.
* Experience working with cloud-based data platforms and an interest in emerging cloud technologies and modern data engineering solutions.
* Experience working with relational databases and structured datasets.
* Knowledge of data transformation, integration and reporting processes.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

What's On Offer?
* Salary up to £45,000.
* Opportunity to join a growing business investing significantly in technology and data.
* Exposure to a broad range of business functions and stakeholders.
* Clear career progression and development opportunities.
* Supportive and collaborative team environment.
* The chance to directly influence business performance through data-driven decision-making.
* Ongoing learning and professional development opportunities.
